digest: By screening a US Food and Drug Administration-approved drug library, we identified dabigatran, a thrombin inhibitor, as a potent dual suppressor of TNF-α and IL-1β signaling that restored chondrocyte metabolism.

Mechanistically, dabigatran binds to BIG2, promoting BIG2-dependent TNFR1 release to dampen TNF-α signaling while enhancing BIG2-mediated IL-1R1 degradation through the autophagy-lysosome pathway to limit IL-1β effects.

digest: Accurate, noninvasive diagnosis of malignant nipple discharge remains a longstanding clinical challenge.
This study evaluated somatic copy-number variations (CNVs) in nipple discharge DNA (ndDNA) as high-fidelity diagnostic biomarkers and explored their cellular origins and shedding mechanisms.
In clinical cohorts, ndDNA-based detection achieved 74.4% sensitivity and 94.4% specificity (AUC = 0.863), significantly outperforming plasma cell-free DNA (AUC = 0.517; p < 0.0001).

digest: We show that cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), the liquid that surrounds and protects the brain, has reduced flow during sleep in the aging human brain.
We identified two mechanisms that contribute to this decline: disrupted sleep and impaired blood vessel function.
These findings suggest that age-related reductions in CSF flow can arise through multiple pathways.
